selected_script.angle: Instantly accessing cleaning tools during kitchen spills by replacing dark closet clutter with organized tile-mounted storage
selected_script.hook: When a spill happens, the last thing you need is a chaotic search through a messy closet pile.

script_record.0-3s: A messy liquid spill on the kitchen floor with a frantic search in a cluttered, dark utility closet full of tangled, falling mops.
script_record.3-6s: A clean, bright laundry room wall where a mop handle is pushed easily into the white silicone roller clip of a light gray wall-mounted holder, instantly securing it.
script_record.6-10s: Close-up of a hand inserting another broom handle into a neighboring clamp, showcasing the secure holding mechanism.
script_record.10-14s: Detail shot of spray bottles and cleaning cloths hanging neatly from the light gray J-hooks beneath the holder.
script_record.14-18s: A wider shot showing the complete 5-clip, 5-hook organization system mounted on tile, holding all tools cleanly off the floor.
script_record.18-20s: Light overlay text showing: 'Upgrade your home organization today.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. 0-3s: A liquid spill happens on a kitchen floor. A person panics and searches in a dark closet where mops and brooms are piled on top of each other, sliding and falling down. 3-6s: Introduce the wall-mounted Multifunctional Mop Holder with Hook (light gray plastic bar, white roller clips, 5 slots, 5 J-hooks) mounted on a light gray tile wall. A hand easily pushes a wet mop handle into a central white silicone roller clip, gripping it securely. 6-10s: Close-up showing another broom handle being clicked into the next slot. Maintain high product detail consistency: light-gray body, white silicone rollers, gray J-hooks, smooth matte plastic texture.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, continuing from the previous segment. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. 0-4s: Close-up of small cleaning accessories (a spray bottle and a microfiber cloth) hanging from the gray J-hooks beneath the mop holder. 4-8s: Medium shot showing the entire light-gray wall-mounted bar with 5 slots and 5 hooks holding various cleaning tools organized vertically on the tiled wall, keeping the floor completely clear. 8-10s: A light CTA on screen: 'Upgrade your home organization today.' Keep identical product identity: light gray housing, white silicone rollers, gray J-hooks, no screws visible.
